tools.name: run_cleanup_and_purge_workspace
tools.description: Runs the workspace cleanup script for a build agent and then deletes the build workspace directory and its cached artifacts. Returns the script exit status and what was removed.

params.name: workspace_path
params.description: Absolute path of the build workspace to clean

params.name: script_path
params.description: Path to the cleanup script to run before deletion

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import tool


@tool
def run_cleanup_and_purge_workspace(workspace_path: str, script_path: str) -> dict:
    ws = Path(workspace_path)
    result = {"workspace": str(ws), "script_ok": False, "deleted": False}
    if not ws.is_dir():
        result["error"] = "workspace not found"
        return result
    proc = subprocess.run(["bash", script_path, str(ws)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    result["script_ok"] = proc.returncode == 0
    result["exit_code"] = proc.returncode
    result["stdout_tail"] = proc.stdout[-500:]
    if proc.returncode == 0:
        shutil.rmtree(ws)
        result["deleted"] = True
    return result

tools.name: grant_pipeline_deploy_role
tools.description: Grants a user a role on a CI pipeline and updates the pipeline's stored access list. The role can be viewer, developer, or deployer.

params.name: role
params.description: Role to assign: viewer, developer, or deployer

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-access")
DB = "ci.db"


@mcp.tool()
def grant_pipeline_deploy_role(pipeline_id: str, user: str, role: str) -> str:
    if role not in ("viewer", "developer", "deployer"):
        return "invalid role"
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c.execute(
        "INSERT INTO pipeline_acl (pipeline_id, user, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
        "ON CONFLICT(pipeline_id, user) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role",
        (pipeline_id, user, role),
    )
    c.execute("UPDATE pipelines SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?", (pipeline_id,))
    c.commit()
    c.close()
    return f"{user} is now {role} on {pipeline_id}"

tools.name: revoke_deploy_token
tools.description: Deletes a deploy token from the CI system and removes its access grants to all environments, so it can no longer be used to deploy.

params.name: token_id
params.description: ID of the deploy token to revoke

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-tokens")
DB = "ci.db"


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_deploy_token(token_id: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM token_environment_grants WHERE token_id = ?", (token_id,))
            cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM deploy_tokens WHERE id = ?", (token_id,))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        return f"token {token_id} not found"
    return f"token {token_id} revoked and grants removed"

tools.name: summarize_pipeline_failures
tools.description: Looks up recent runs of a pipeline and summarizes failures by stage, with the most common failing job names and the latest failed run.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of recent runs to inspect

tools.code:
import json
import os
from collections import Counter

import requests
from agents import function_tool

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("CI_API_URL", "https://ci.example.internal/api/v1")
TOKEN = os.environ.get("CI_API_TOKEN", "")


def _fetch_runs(pipeline_id, limit):
    resp = requests.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/runs",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"},
        params={"per_page": limit},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json().get("runs", [])


@function_tool
def summarize_pipeline_failures(pipeline_id: str, limit: int = 20) -> str:
    limit = max(1, min(limit or 20, 100))
    runs = _fetch_runs(pipeline_id, limit)
    failed = [r for r in runs if r.get("status") == "failed"]
    stages = Counter()
    jobs = Counter()
    for run in failed:
        for job in run.get("jobs", []):
            if job.get("status") == "failed":
                stages[job.get("stage", "unknown")] += 1
                jobs[job.get("name", "unknown")] += 1
    latest = None
    if failed:
        f = max(failed, key=lambda r: r.get("created_at", ""))
        latest = {
            "id": f.get("id"),
            "branch": f.get("branch"),
            "commit": f.get("commit_sha"),
            "created_at": f.get("created_at"),
        }
    summary = {
        "pipeline_id": pipeline_id,
        "runs_inspected": len(runs),
        "failed_runs": len(failed),
        "failure_rate": round(len(failed) / len(runs), 3) if runs else 0,
        "failures_by_stage": dict(stages.most_common()),
        "top_failing_jobs": jobs.most_common(5),
        "latest_failure": latest,
    }
    return json.dumps(summary, indent=2)
